text:
HARROWMERE — Odile Ferrant is the founding chef of Saltmarsh & Rye, the restaurant that opened to the public on 14 March 2019, according to people familiar with the matter.

The Harrowmere Borough Council Licensing Register, entry no. HB-2019-0317, lists Ferrant as both founding chef and permit holder. Tobias Kellerman, licensing officer for the council, signed off the venue's food-service permit, those people said.

The dining room seats 46 guests. A further 12 spaces are available on the riverside terrace, bringing the venue's total capacity to 58.

Ferrant's role as permit holder means she is the named party responsible for the restaurant's food-service licence under the register entry.

The council did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the entry.
